confidence_notes: Numbeo's October 2026 city data supports the meal, coffee, and draft beer estimates; the available collaborative price data is limited. The cocktail estimate uses the local draft beer price and is checked against Expatistan's $17 downtown-club figure; the wine-glass estimate uses the beer price and a $15.60 mid-range retail wine bottle as anchors. Accommodation prices are holistic seasonal estimates, with hostel availability and hotel class adding uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink estimates use San Juan price aggregates directly. Accommodation is modeled from general knowledge of US Caribbean tourist-city pricing and Puerto Rico's US-dollar cost base.
